summary: Layer 1B expansion found one obvious reference anchor and three less-obvious US-listed candidates tied to AI data-center electrical and thermal bottlenecks. The strongest underfollowed mapping is Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and packaged electrical systems, followed by AAON for customized air-side and liquid-cooling data-center equipment and Bel Fuse for power conversion, protection, connectors, magnetics, and high-density data-center component exposure.
